[L; Gr.an assembly or meeting, whence a church; to call forth or convoke; to call.] Pertaining or relating to the church; as ecclesiastical discipline or government; ecclesiastical affairs, history or policy; ecclesiastical courts. Ecclesiastical State is the body of the clergy. ECCLESIAS'TIC, noun A person in orders, or consecrated to the service of the church and the ministry of religion.
